ja.R: 壁にしっくいを塗る預言者たちに言いなさい。その壁は倒れる。激しい雨が降り、ひょうが降り、強い風が吹いて、壁を引き裂く。

decisions.choice: and you, hailstones, will fall: the storm is addressed directly
alternatives: "and I will send hailstones", reading the letters differently
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "and you", as if the LORD calls on the hailstones. A small change in vowels gives "and I will give hailstones", as some ancient versions read. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: rain, hail and wind: the storm of God's judgment, the Babylonian attack
decisions.reason: A storm that washes away a wall is a picture of judgment (Isaiah 28:17; compare Matthew 7:24-27). The LORD says in 13:13 that the storm is his own anger.

decisions.choice: tear the wall apart
decisions.reason: Readable says what the wind does to the wall.

decisions.choice: "너희 우박덩이들아, 떨어져라" keeps the storm addressed directly
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to speak to the hailstones (see the shared decision); Literal keeps the vocative, and Balanced keeps "너희" inside a statement.

decisions.choice: "{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}, piedras de granizo, {{plural_you:caerán|caeréis}}"
decisions.reason: The hailstones are addressed directly, so the verb takes plural_you; the alternative is feminine, agreeing with "piedras".

decisions.choice: "mvua ya mawe" for hailstones, addressed as "ninyi"
decisions.reason: Swahili names hail "mvua ya mawe"; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew's direct address to the hail with "ninyi ... mtaanguka".

decisions.choice: हे ओलो
decisions.reason: The storm is addressed directly in Hebrew (m1); Literal and Balanced keep the address, Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: geshem shotef "押し流す雨" (L), "大雨" (B), "激しい雨" (R); 'avne 'elgavish "雹の石" (L), "雹" (B), "ひょう" (R, kana); the hail addressed at L, B ("あなたがた、雹の石よ").
decisions.reason: The storm is addressed directly (m1, uncertain); the storm of God's judgment is the Babylonian attack (m2). R follows the English R, which does not address the hail.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֖ה נָפַ֣ל הַקִּ֑יר הֲלוֹא֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אַיֵּ֥ה הַטִּ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר טַחְתֶּֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And behold, falls the wall; [will it] not be said to you, Where [is] the whitewash that you smeared?

en.L: And look, when the wall has fallen, will it not be said to you, "Where [is] the whitewash that you smeared [on it]?"
en.B: When the wall falls, will people not ask you, "Where is the whitewash you covered it with?"
en.R: When the wall falls, people will ask you, "What good was the whitewash you put on it?"

pt.L: E eis que, quando a parede cair, não se dirá a vocês: "Onde [está] a cal com que [a] rebocaram?"
pt.B: Quando a parede cair, será que ninguém vai perguntar a vocês: "Onde está a cal com que vocês a cobriram?"
pt.R: Quando a parede cair, as pessoas vão perguntar a vocês: "De que adiantou a cal que vocês passaram nela?"

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 그 담이 무너지면, 사람들이 너희에게 "너희가 칠한 회칠은 어디 있느냐?" 하고 말하지 않겠느냐?
ko.B: 그 담이 무너지면, 사람들이 너희에게 "너희가 칠한 회칠은 어디 갔느냐?" 하고 묻지 않겠느냐?
ko.R: 그 담이 무너지면 사람들이 너희에게 "너희가 칠한 회칠이 무슨 소용이 있었느냐?" 하고 물을 것이다.

fr.L: Et voici, quand le mur sera tombé, ne vous dira-t-on pas : « Où [est] la chaux dont vous [l’]avez enduit ? »
fr.B: Quand le mur tombera, ne vous demandera-t-on pas : « Où est la chaux dont vous l’avez badigeonné ? »
fr.R: Quand le mur tombera, les gens vous demanderont : « À quoi a servi la chaux que vous avez mise dessus ? »

es.L: Y he aquí, cuando la pared haya caído, ¿no se {{plural_you:les|os}} dirá: «¿Dónde [está] la cal con que la {{plural_you:recubrieron|recubristeis}}?»?
es.B: Cuando la pared se caiga, la gente {{plural_you:les|os}} preguntará: «¿Dónde está la cal con que la {{plural_you:cubrieron|cubristeis}}?».
es.R: Cuando la pared se caiga, la gente {{plural_you:les|os}} preguntará: «¿De qué sirvió la cal con que la {{plural_you:cubrieron|cubristeis}}?».

sw.L: Na tazama, ukuta ukisha kuanguka, je, hamtaambiwa, "Iko wapi chokaa mliyoupaka [ukuta]?"
sw.B: Ukuta utakapoanguka, je, watu hawatawauliza, "Iko wapi ile chokaa mliyoupaka?"
sw.R: Ukuta utakapoanguka, watu watawauliza, "Ile chokaa mliyoupaka ilifaa nini?"

vi.L: Kìa, khi bức tường đã đổ, chẳng phải người ta sẽ nói với các ngươi: "Lớp vôi các ông đã trát [lên] đâu rồi?" hay sao?
vi.B: Khi tường đổ, chẳng lẽ người ta không hỏi các ngươi: "Lớp vôi các ông quét lên đâu rồi?"
vi.R: Khi bức tường đổ, người ta sẽ hỏi các ngươi: "Lớp vôi các ông quét lên đó có ích gì đâu?"

am.L: እነሆም፣ ግድግዳው በወደቀ ጊዜ «የለሰናችሁበት ኖራ የት [አለ]?» አይሏችሁምን?
am.B: ግድግዳው ሲወድቅ ሰዎች «የለሰናችሁበት ኖራ የት አለ?» ብለው አይጠይቋችሁምን?
am.R: ግድግዳው ሲወድቅ ሰዎች «የለሰናችሁበት ኖራ ምን ጠቀመ?» ብለው ይጠይቋችኋል።

hi.L: और देखो, जब दीवार गिर जाएगी, तो क्या तुमसे यह न कहा जाएगा, "जो चूना तुमने [उस पर] पोता था, वह कहाँ [है]?"
hi.B: जब दीवार गिर जाएगी, तो क्या लोग तुमसे नहीं पूछेंगे, "वह चूना कहाँ है जो तुमने उस पर पोता था?"
hi.R: जब दीवार गिर जाएगी, तो लोग तुमसे पूछेंगे, "जो चूना तुमने उस पर पोता था, उससे क्या लाभ हुआ?"

ru.L: И вот, упала стена; разве не скажут вам: «Где побелка, которой вы обмазывали [её]?»
ru.B: Когда стена упадёт, разве не спросят вас: «Где же побелка, которой вы её обмазали?»
ru.R: Когда стена упадёт, люди спросят вас: «Чем помогла побелка, которой вы её покрыли?»

ja.L: そして見なさい、壁が倒れたとき、あなたがたは、「あなたがたが塗ったしっくいはどこにあるのか？」と言われないだろうか？
ja.B: 壁が倒れたとき、人々はあなたがたに、「あなたがたが塗ったしっくいはどこにあるのか？」と尋ねないだろうか？
ja.R: 壁が倒れると、人々はあなたたちに、「あなたたちが塗ったしっくいは、何の役に立ったのか？」と尋ねる。

decisions.choice: "Where is the whitewash?": the mocking question when the wall is gone
decisions.reason: The coating hid the weakness but could not hold the wall up. The question exposes the prophets' reassurances as worthless.

decisions.choice: the rhetorical question made a statement: "la gente {{plural_you:les|os}} preguntará"
decisions.reason: A quoted question inside a question is heavy in Spanish; Balanced states what the rhetorical question implies, as Readable does.

decisions.choice: the people to the prophets: "các ông"
decisions.reason: Inside the people's mocking question the prophets are addressed as ordinary people address men of standing; God's own address to them stays "các ngươi".

decisions.choice: "しっくいはどこにあるのか？" (L, B), "何の役に立ったのか？" (R), as the English.
decisions.reason: The mocking question when the wall is gone (m1).

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וּבִקַּעְתִּ֥י רֽוּחַ־סְעָר֖וֹת בַּֽחֲמָתִ֑י וְגֶ֤שֶׁם שֹׁטֵף֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַבְנֵ֥י אֶלְגָּבִ֖ישׁ בְּחֵמָ֥ה לְכָלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: I will make burst out a wind of storms in my wrath, and a rain flooding in my anger there will be, and stones of hail in wrath for destruction.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: I will make a stormy wind break out in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath, and there will be a flooding rain in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger, and hailstones in wrath to destroy completely.
en.B: Therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: In {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath I will let loose a violent wind; in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger there will be torrents of rain, and hailstones in fury to destroy it.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: In {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great anger I will send a strong wind, pouring rain and hailstones to destroy the wall completely.

pt.L: Por isso, assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Farei irromper um vento tempestuoso no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor, e haverá uma chuva torrencial na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira, e pedras de granizo com furor para destruir por completo.
pt.B: Por isso, assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: No {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor soltarei um vento violento; na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira virão chuvas torrenciais, e pedras de granizo com fúria para destruí-la.
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: Na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} grande ira vou mandar um vento forte, uma chuva pesada e pedras de granizo para destruir a parede por completo.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 내 진노 가운데 폭풍을 터뜨리고, 내 분노 가운데 폭우가 쏟아지며, 진노 가운데 우박덩이가 [쏟아져] 모든 것을 멸할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 진노하여 사나운 바람을 일으키겠다. 내가 분노하여 억수 같은 비를 쏟고, 격노하여 우박덩이를 내려 그 담을 부수어 버리겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내가 크게 분노하여 거센 바람과 큰비와 우박을 보내서 그 담을 완전히 무너뜨리겠다.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je ferai éclater un vent de tempête dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur, et il y aura une pluie torrentielle dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, et des pierres de grêle dans [{{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}}] fureur, pour détruire entièrement.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur, je déchaînerai un vent violent ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, il y aura des torrents de pluie, et des grêlons tomberont avec fureur pour le détruire.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande colère, j’enverrai un vent violent, une pluie battante et des grêlons pour détruire complètement le mur.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Haré estallar un viento tempestuoso en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, y habrá lluvia torrencial en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, y piedras de granizo en furor para destruir por completo.
es.B: Por eso, el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: En {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor desataré un viento violento; en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira vendrá un aguacero torrencial, y granizo con furor para destruirla.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: En {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran enojo enviaré un viento fuerte, una lluvia torrencial y piedras de granizo para destruir la pared por completo.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Nitafanya upepo wa dhoruba uvume kwa nguvu katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na mvua ya gharika itakuja katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na mvua ya mawe katika ghadhabu ili kuangamiza kabisa.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nitaachilia upepo mkali; katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itakuja mvua kubwa ya mafuriko, na mvua ya mawe katika ghadhabu ili kuuangamiza.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kubwa nitatuma upepo mkali, mvua kubwa na mvua ya mawe ili kuuangamiza ukuta kabisa.

vi.L: Vì vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Trong cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho gió bão bùng lên; trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ có mưa lũ, và mưa đá trong cơn thịnh nộ để hủy diệt hoàn toàn.
vi.B: Vì thế, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Trong cơn thịnh nộ, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho cuồng phong nổi dậy; trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mưa sẽ trút xuống như lũ, và mưa đá sẽ đổ xuống trong cơn thịnh nộ để hủy diệt nó.
vi.R: Vậy đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Trong cơn giận lớn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai gió mạnh, mưa lớn và mưa đá đến để phá hủy hoàn toàn bức tường ấy.

am.L: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በመዓቴ ዐውሎ ነፋስን አስነሣለሁ፤ በቁጣዬም የሚያጥለቀልቅ ዝናብ ይሆናል፤ ፈጽሞ ያጠፋም ዘንድ በመዓት የበረዶ ድንጋዮች [ይወርዳሉ]።
am.B: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በመዓቴ ብርቱ ነፋስን እለቃለሁ፤ በቁጣዬም ኃይለኛ ዝናብ ይወርዳል፤ ግድግዳውንም ለማጥፋት በመዓት የበረዶ ድንጋዮች ይወርዳሉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ በታላቅ ቁጣዬ ግድግዳውን ፈጽሞ ለማጥፋት ብርቱ ነፋስን፣ ኃይለኛ ዝናብንና የበረዶ ድንጋይን እልካለሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: मैं अपनी जलजलाहट में आँधी फोड़ दूँगा, और मेरे क्रोध में मूसलाधार वर्षा होगी, और जलजलाहट में पूरा नाश करने के लिए ओले [बरसेंगे]।
hi.B: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: अपनी जलजलाहट में मैं प्रचंड आँधी छोड़ दूँगा; मेरे क्रोध में मूसलाधार वर्षा होगी, और उसे नाश करने के लिए रोष में ओले बरसेंगे।
hi.R: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: अपने बड़े क्रोध में मैं तेज़ आँधी, भारी वर्षा और ओले भेजूँगा, ताकि दीवार पूरी तरह नाश हो जाए।

ru.L: Поэтому так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Я пущу бурный вихрь в {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} ярости, и проливной дождь будет в {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} гневе, и градины в ярости — для истребления.
ru.B: Поэтому так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: В {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} ярости {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пущу бурный ветер, в {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} гневе хлынет проливной дождь, и в ярости посыплются градины, чтобы разрушить её.
ru.R: Поэтому вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: В {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} великом гневе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пошлю сильный ветер, проливной дождь и град, чтобы совсем разрушить стену.

ja.L: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは憤りをもって嵐の風を吹き起こし、怒りをもって押し流す雨を降らせ、憤りをもって雹の石を降らせて、滅ぼし尽くす。
ja.B: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは憤りのうちに激しい風を吹き荒れさせ、怒りのうちに大雨を降り注がせ、憤りのうちに雹を降らせて、それを滅ぼし尽くす。
ja.R: だから、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは激しい怒りをもって、強い風と、激しい雨と、ひょうを送り、その壁をすっかり壊してしまう。

decisions.choice: in my wrath, in my anger: the storm is the LORD's own judgment
decisions.reason: The storm of 13:11 is not chance: it comes from the LORD. The judgment the prophets denied is his doing.

decisions.choice: "진노" (L, B), "분노" (R) for chemah; "분노" for 'af
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words: R uses the plainer 분노 throughout, so it does not keep the two Hebrew words apart.

decisions.choice: "furor" (L, B); "enojo" (R)
decisions.reason: Chemah as the terms note sets it for Ezekiel; "ira" is kept for 'af.

decisions.choice: "ghadhabu" (L, B); "hasira" (R) for wrath (chemah)
decisions.reason: Wrath is "ghadhabu" at Literal and Balanced and the everyday "hasira" at Readable; the Hebrew 'af (anger) is "hasira". Used the same way through these chapters.

decisions.reason: The terms note's word for chemah; 'af (anger) is "cơn giận". Used unchanged through these chapters.

decisions.choice: ’fureur’ (L, B); ’colère’ (R) for chemah, and ’colère’ for af, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The book’s term list: Literal and Balanced keep the stronger ’fureur’ for chemah, Readable says ’colère’.

decisions.choice: chemah "憤り" (L, B), "激しい怒り" (R); 'af "怒り", as notes/EZK-EZK-1.md; the storm words of 13:11 repeated.
decisions.reason: The storm is the LORD's own judgment (m1).

source.text: וְהָ֨רַסְתִּ֜י אֶת־הַקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־טַחְתֶּ֥ם תָּפֵ֛ל וְהִגַּעְתִּ֥יהוּ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְנִגְלָ֣ה יְסֹד֑וֹ וְנָֽפְלָה֙ וּכְלִיתֶ֣ם בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will tear down the wall that you smeared [with] whitewash and bring it to the ground, and its foundation will be laid bare; and it will fall, and you will be destroyed in its midst; and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And I will tear down the wall that you smeared with whitewash and bring it down to the ground, and its foundation will be laid bare; and it will fall, and you will be consumed in its midst; and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will tear down the wall you covered with whitewash and level it to the ground, so that its foundation is laid bare. When it falls, you will be destroyed under it. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will knock down the wall you covered with whitewash. I will flatten it to the ground so that its foundation is exposed. When it falls, you will die under it. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: E derrubarei a parede que vocês rebocaram com cal e a lançarei por terra, e o seu alicerce ficará descoberto; e ela cairá, e vocês serão consumidos no meio dela; e vocês saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Derrubarei a parede que vocês cobriram de cal e a porei no chão, de modo que o seu alicerce fique à mostra. Quando ela cair, vocês serão destruídos debaixo dela. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vou derrubar a parede que vocês pintaram de cal. Vou deixá-la no chão, com o alicerce à vista. Quando ela cair, vocês vão morrer debaixo dela. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 회칠한 그 담을 내가 허물어 땅에 쓰러뜨려, 그 기초가 드러날 것이다. 그것이 무너지면 너희가 그 가운데서 멸망할 것이다. 그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 회칠한 그 담을 내가 허물어 땅바닥에 쓰러뜨리고, 그 기초가 드러나게 하겠다. 그 담이 무너질 때 너희도 그 밑에 깔려 망할 것이다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희가 회칠한 그 담을 내가 무너뜨리겠다. 그 담을 땅바닥에 쓰러뜨려 기초가 다 드러나게 하겠다. 그 담이 무너질 때 너희는 그 밑에 깔려 죽을 것이다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

fr.L: Et j’abattrai le mur que vous avez enduit de chaux, je le ferai toucher le sol, et ses fondations seront mises à nu ; il tombera, et vous serez anéantis au milieu de lui ; et vous saurez que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: J’abattrai le mur que vous avez badigeonné de chaux et je le raserai jusqu’au sol, si bien que ses fondations seront mises à nu. Quand il tombera, vous périrez sous ses décombres. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je renverserai le mur que vous avez recouvert de chaux. Je le raserai, et on verra ses fondations. Quand il tombera, vous mourrez dessous. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y derribaré la pared que {{plural_you:recubrieron|recubristeis}} con cal, y la echaré por tierra, y quedará al descubierto su cimiento; y caerá, y {{plural_you:serán consumidos|seréis consumidos}} en medio de ella; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Derribaré la pared que {{plural_you:cubrieron|cubristeis}} de cal y la arrasaré hasta el suelo, de modo que su cimiento quede al descubierto. Cuando caiga, {{plural_you:serán destruidos|seréis destruidos}} debajo de ella. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Echaré abajo la pared que {{plural_you:cubrieron|cubristeis}} de cal. La derribaré hasta el suelo, y sus cimientos quedarán a la vista. Cuando caiga, {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}} debajo de ella. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitaubomoa ukuta mliopaka chokaa na kuuangusha chini, na msingi wake utafunuliwa; nao utaanguka, nanyi mtaangamizwa katikati yake; nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitaubomoa ukuta mliopaka chokaa na kuusawazisha na ardhi, hata msingi wake ukaachwa wazi. Utakapoanguka, mtaangamizwa chini yake. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitaubomoa ukuta mliopaka chokaa. Nitaubomoa mpaka chini, hata msingi wake uonekane. Utakapoanguka, mtakufa chini yake. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ phá đổ bức tường mà các ngươi đã trát vôi, và làm cho nó sập xuống đất, và nền của nó sẽ bị lộ ra; nó sẽ đổ, và các ngươi sẽ bị tiêu diệt ở giữa nó; và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ta sẽ phá đổ bức tường các ngươi đã quét vôi và san nó bằng mặt đất, để nền nó lộ ra. Khi tường đổ, các ngươi sẽ bị diệt vong dưới đó. Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đập đổ bức tường các ngươi đã quét vôi. Ta sẽ san bằng nó xuống đất, đến nỗi nền móng của nó lộ ra. Khi tường đổ, các ngươi sẽ chết dưới đó. Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

am.L: በኖራም የለሰናችሁትን ግድግዳ አፈርሳለሁ፤ ወደ መሬትም እጥለዋለሁ፤ መሠረቱም ይገለጣል፤ ይወድቃልም፤ እናንተም በመካከሉ ትጠፋላችሁ፤ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።
am.B: በኖራ የለሰናችሁትን ግድግዳ አፈርሳለሁ፤ መሠረቱ እስኪገለጥም ድረስ ከመሬት ጋር አስተካክለዋለሁ። ሲወድቅም እናንተ ከሥሩ ትጠፋላችሁ። በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።
am.R: በኖራ የለሰናችሁትን ግድግዳ አፈርሰዋለሁ። መሠረቱ እስኪታይ ድረስ ከመሬት ጋር አደባልቀዋለሁ። ሲወድቅም ከሥሩ ትሞታላችሁ። በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።

hi.L: और जिस दीवार पर तुमने चूना पोता है, उसे मैं ढा दूँगा और धरती पर गिरा दूँगा, और उसकी नींव खुल जाएगी; और वह गिरेगी, और तुम उसके बीच नाश हो जाओगे; और तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]।
hi.B: जिस दीवार पर तुमने चूना पोता है, उसे मैं ढाकर ज़मीन के बराबर कर दूँगा, यहाँ तक कि उसकी नींव खुल जाएगी। जब वह गिरेगी, तब तुम उसके नीचे नाश हो जाओगे। तब तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।
hi.R: जिस दीवार पर तुमने चूना पोता है, उसे मैं गिरा दूँगा। मैं उसे ज़मीन के बराबर कर दूँगा, यहाँ तक कि उसकी नींव दिखाई देने लगेगी। जब वह गिरेगी, तब तुम उसके नीचे दबकर मर जाओगे। तब तुम जान लोगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разрушу стену, которую вы обмазали побелкой, и повергну её на землю, и обнажится её основание; и она упадёт, и вы погибнете посреди неё; и узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Я разрушу стену, которую вы обмазали побелкой, и сровняю её с землёй, так что обнажится её основание. Когда она упадёт, вы погибнете под ней. Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Я разрушу стену, которую вы побелили. Я сровняю её с землёй, так что станет видно её основание. Когда она упадёт, вы погибнете под ней. Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: わたしは、あなたがたがしっくいを塗った壁を打ち壊し、それを地に倒す。その土台はあらわになる。それは倒れ、あなたがたはそのただ中で滅びる。そしてあなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。
ja.B: わたしは、あなたがたがしっくいを塗った壁を打ち壊し、地面に打ち倒す。その土台はむき出しになる。壁が倒れるとき、あなたがたはその下で滅びる。そのとき、あなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちがしっくいを塗った壁を打ち壊す。それを地面に倒し、土台がむき出しになるようにする。壁が倒れると、あなたたちはその下敷きになって死ぬ。そのとき、あなたたちは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。

decisions.choice: it will fall, and you will be destroyed in its midst: the wall, or the city it stands for
decisions.reason: The verb "fall" is feminine, but the word for "wall" is masculine. The feminine may point to the city, which the wall stands for, so that the prophets die in the fall of Jerusalem. The picture and the event are the same.

records.literal_gloss: And I will spend my wrath on the wall and on [those who] smeared it [with] whitewash; and I will say to you, Not the wall, and not those smearing it,

en.L: And I will spend {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on the wall and on those who smeared it with whitewash, and I will say to you, "No more [is] the wall, and no more those who smeared it,"
en.B: I will spend {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on the wall and on those who covered it with whitewash, and I will say to you, "Gone is the wall, and gone are those who whitewashed it,"
en.R: I will use up all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger on the wall and on those who covered it with whitewash. Then I will tell you, "The wall is gone, and so are the people who whitewashed it."

pt.L: E esgotarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor sobre a parede e sobre os que a rebocaram com cal, e direi a vocês: "Não [existe mais] a parede, e não [existem mais] os que a rebocaram",
pt.B: Descarregarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor sobre a parede e sobre os que a cobriram de cal, e direi a vocês: "Acabou-se a parede, e acabaram-se os que a caiaram",
pt.R: Vou descarregar toda a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira sobre a parede e sobre os que a pintaram de cal. Depois vou dizer a vocês: "A parede acabou, e as pessoas que a pintaram de cal também."

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그 담과 그것에 회칠한 자들에게 내 진노를 다 쏟고, 너희에게 "그 담도 없어졌고, 그것에 회칠한 자들도 없어졌다." 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그 담과 그 담에 회칠한 자들에게 내 진노를 다 쏟고 너희에게 "담도 사라졌고, 그 담에 회칠한 자들도 사라졌다." 하고 말하겠다.
ko.R: 내가 그 담과 그 담에 회칠한 자들에게 내 분노를 다 쏟겠다. 그런 다음 너희에게 "담도 없어졌고, 회칠한 사람들도 없어졌다." 하고 말하겠다.

fr.L: Et j’épuiserai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur sur le mur et sur ceux qui l’ont enduit de chaux, et je vous dirai : « Plus de mur, et plus de ceux qui l’enduisaient »,
fr.B: J’épuiserai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur sur le mur et sur ceux qui l’ont badigeonné de chaux, et je vous dirai : « Le mur n’est plus, et ceux qui l’ont badigeonné ne sont plus »,
fr.R: Je déverserai toute {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère sur le mur et sur ceux qui l’ont recouvert de chaux. Puis je vous dirai : « Le mur a disparu, et ceux qui l’ont recouvert de chaux aussi. »

es.L: Y desahogaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor en la pared y en los que la recubrieron con cal, y {{plural_you:les|os}} diré: «No [existe] la pared, ni los que la recubrieron»,
es.B: Descargaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre la pared y sobre los que la cubrieron de cal, y {{plural_you:les|os}} diré: «Ya no está la pared, ni están los que la blanquearon»,
es.R: Descargaré todo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo sobre la pared y sobre los que la cubrieron de cal. Entonces {{plural_you:les|os}} diré: «La pared ya no existe, y tampoco los que la blanquearon».

sw.L: Nami nitaimaliza ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu ya ukuta na juu ya wale walioupaka chokaa, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaambia, "Hakuna tena ukuta, wala hakuna tena wale walioupaka,"

sw.R: Nitaitumia hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote juu ya ukuta na juu ya wale walioupaka chokaa. Kisha nitawaambia, "Ukuta umetoweka, na watu walioupaka chokaa wametoweka pia."

vi.L: Ta sẽ trút hết cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên bức tường và trên những kẻ đã trát vôi nó, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói với các ngươi: "Bức tường không còn nữa, những kẻ trát vôi nó cũng không còn nữa,"

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} ярость на стену и на обмазавших её побелкой, и скажу вам: «Нет стены, и нет обмазывавших её»,
ru.B: Я изолью {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} ярость на стену и на тех, кто обмазал её побелкой, и скажу вам: «Нет больше стены, и нет тех, кто её белил»,
ru.R: Я изолью весь {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев на стену и на тех, кто её побелил. Тогда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} скажу вам: «Стены больше нет, и нет тех, кто её белил.»

ja.L: わたしは壁と、それにしっくいを塗った者たちとに、わたしの憤りを注ぎ尽くし、あなたがたに言う。「壁はもうない。それにしっくいを塗った者たちも、もういない」と。
ja.B: わたしは壁と、それにしっくいを塗った者たちとに、憤りを注ぎ尽くす。そして、あなたがたに言う。「壁は消えうせ、それにしっくいを塗った者たちも消えうせた」と。
ja.R: わたしは、壁と、それにしっくいを塗った人々に、激しい怒りをすべてぶちまける。そして、あなたたちに言う。「壁はなくなった。それにしっくいを塗った人々も、いなくなった。」

hi.R: मेरा मतलब इस्राएल के उन नबियों से है जो यरूशलेम के बारे में भविष्यवाणी करते थे। वे उस नगर के लिए शान्ति के दर्शन देखते थे, जबकि शान्ति नहीं थी, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: пророков Израиля, пророчествовавших Иерусалиму и видевших для него видение мира, а мира нет, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: тех пророков Израиля, которые пророчествовали Иерусалиму и видели для него видения мира, когда мира не было, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Я говорю о пророках Израиля, которые пророчествовали Иерусалиму. Они видели для города видения мира, когда мира не было, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: [それは]エルサレムについて預言し、平和がないのに、その都のために平和の幻を見たイスラエルの預言者たちである――{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: それは、エルサレムに向かって預言し、平和などないのに、その都のために平和の幻を見たイスラエルの預言者たちである、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: つまり、エルサレムに向かって預言したイスラエルの預言者たちのことだ。平和はないのに、彼らは、この都について平和の幻を見た、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: a vision of peace, and there is no peace: the charge of 13:10
decisions.reason: The section on the prophets ends where it began (13:10), with the false promise of peace.

decisions.choice: I mean the prophets of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable makes this verse a sentence of its own and says that it names "those who whitewashed it" in 13:15.

decisions.choice: "[그들은] … 예언자들이다" (L), "그들은 … 예언자들이다" (B) as a new sentence
decisions.reason: The English runs verse 16 on from the quotation of verse 15 as an apposition; Korean cannot hang a noun phrase after a closed quotation, so it names the prophets in a sentence of its own and keeps the content in verse 16.

decisions.choice: 13:16 names those who whitewashed the wall in 13:15 as a new sentence: "[それは]…預言者たちである" (L), "それは、…預言者たちである" (B), R "つまり…のことだ" as the English R "I mean"; the city "その都" / "この都", never 彼女.
decisions.reason: Japanese cannot hang a noun phrase after a finished quotation as the English does; a vision of peace when there is no peace is the charge of 13:10 (m1).

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨יךָ֙ אֶל־בְּנ֣וֹת עַמְּךָ֔ הַמִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וֹת מִֽלִּבְּהֶ֑ן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, son of man, set your face against [the] daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,

en.L: And you, son of man, set your face toward the daughters of your people who are prophesying out of their own heart, and prophesy against them,
en.B: Now you, son of man, turn to face the women of your people who prophesy out of their own minds, and prophesy against them,
en.R: Now, son of man, turn toward the women among your people who make up their own prophecies. Prophesy against them.

pt.L: E tu, filho do homem, põe o teu rosto em direção às filhas do teu povo que estão profetizando do próprio coração, e profetiza contra elas,
pt.B: Agora tu, filho do homem, volta o rosto para as mulheres do teu povo que profetizam pela própria cabeça, e profetiza contra elas,
pt.R: Agora, filho do homem, vira-te para as mulheres do teu povo que inventam as próprias profecias. Profetiza contra elas.

ko.L: 그리고 너 사람의 아들아, 자기 마음에서 [나온 것을] 예언하는 네 백성의 딸들에게 네 얼굴을 향하고, 그들을 향하여 예언하여
ko.B: 이제 너 사람의 아들아, 자기 생각에서 나온 것을 예언하는 네 백성의 여자들을 마주 보고 서서, 그들을 향하여 예언하여
ko.R: 이제 사람의 아들아, 네 백성 가운데 자기들이 꾸며 낸 예언을 하는 여자들 쪽으로 돌아서라. 그리고 그들을 꾸짖어 예언하여라.

fr.L: Et toi, fils d’homme, tourne ta face vers les filles de ton peuple qui prophétisent de leur propre cœur, et prophétise contre elles,
fr.B: Et toi, fils d’homme, tourne ton regard vers les femmes de ton peuple qui prophétisent selon leur propre idée, et prophétise contre elles,
fr.R: Maintenant, fils d’homme, tourne-toi vers les femmes de ton peuple qui inventent leurs propres prophéties. Prophétise contre elles.

es.L: Y tú, hijo de hombre, pon tu rostro hacia las hijas de tu pueblo que profetizan según su propio corazón, y profetiza contra ellas,
es.B: Y ahora tú, hijo de hombre, vuélvete de cara a las mujeres de tu pueblo que profetizan lo que sale de su propia mente, y profetiza contra ellas,
es.R: Ahora, hijo de hombre, vuélvete hacia las mujeres de tu pueblo que inventan sus propias profecías. Profetiza contra ellas.

sw.L: Nawe, mwana wa binadamu, kaza uso wako kuelekea binti za watu wako wanaotabiri kutoka katika mioyo yao wenyewe, nawe utabiri dhidi yao,
sw.B: Sasa wewe, mwana wa binadamu, geuka uwaelekee wanawake wa watu wako wanaotabiri mawazo yao wenyewe, nawe utabiri dhidi yao,
sw.R: Sasa, mwana wa binadamu, geuka uwaelekee wanawake miongoni mwa watu wako wanaobuni unabii wao wenyewe. Tabiri dhidi yao.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, hỡi con người, hãy xây mặt về phía các con gái của dân ngươi, là những kẻ nói tiên tri theo lòng riêng của mình, và hãy nói tiên tri nghịch cùng chúng,
vi.B: Còn con, hỡi con người, hãy quay mặt về phía những người nữ trong dân con, là những kẻ nói tiên tri theo ý riêng của mình, và hãy nói tiên tri nghịch cùng chúng,
vi.R: Hỡi con người, bây giờ con hãy quay về phía những người phụ nữ trong dân con, là những kẻ tự bịa ra lời tiên tri. Hãy nói tiên tri nghịch cùng chúng.

am.L: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ከገዛ ልባቸው ትንቢት ወደሚናገሩት ወደ ሕዝብህ ሴቶች ልጆች ፊትህን አቅና፤ በእነርሱም ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር፤
am.B: አሁንም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ከገዛ አእምሮአቸው አውጥተው ትንቢት ወደሚናገሩት ወደ ሕዝብህ ሴቶች ፊትህን አቅና፤ በእነርሱም ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር፤
am.R: አሁንም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ በሕዝብህ መካከል የራሳቸውን ትንቢት ፈጥረው ወደሚናገሩት ሴቶች ዞር በል። በእነርሱም ላይ ትንቢት ተናገር።

hi.L: और तुम, हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, अपनी प्रजा की उन बेटियों की ओर अपना मुख करो जो अपने ही मन से भविष्यवाणी करती हैं, और उनके विरुद्ध भविष्यवाणी करो,
hi.B: और अब, हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, अपने लोगों की उन स्त्रियों की ओर मुँह करो जो अपने ही मन से भविष्यवाणी करती हैं, और उनके विरुद्ध भविष्यवाणी करो,
hi.R: अब, हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, अपने लोगों के बीच उन स्त्रियों की ओर मुड़ो जो अपनी ओर से भविष्यवाणियाँ गढ़ लेती हैं। उनके विरुद्ध भविष्यवाणी करो।

ru.L: А ты, сын человеческий, обрати своё лицо к дочерям твоего народа, пророчествующим от своего сердца, и пророчествуй против них,
ru.B: А ты, сын человеческий, повернись лицом к женщинам твоего народа, которые пророчествуют от своего ума, и пророчествуй против них,
ru.R: А теперь, сын человеческий, повернись к тем женщинам твоего народа, которые сами придумывают свои пророчества. Пророчествуй против них.

ja.L: そしてあなた、人の子よ、自分の心から預言している、あなたの民の娘たちに、あなたの顔を向け、彼女たちに向かって預言しなさい。
ja.B: 人の子よ、自分の思いから預言している、あなたの民の女たちの方に顔を向け、彼女たちに向かって預言しなさい。
ja.R: 人よ、自分で預言を作り上げている、あなたの民の女たちの方を向きなさい。彼女たちに向かって預言しなさい。

decisions.choice: women who prophesy: women of Israel who acted as prophets, here false ones
decisions.reason: Israel knew women prophets: Miriam (Exodus 15:20), Deborah (Judges 4:4), Huldah (2 Kings 22:14). These women are condemned for prophesying "out of their own heart", as the men were (13:2), and for practices that look like magic (13:18-20), not for being women.

decisions.choice: set your face toward: turn toward them to speak against them (see 6:2)
decisions.reason: See 6:2.

decisions.choice: set your face toward (L); turn to face (B); turn toward (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this phrase in Ezekiel. Balanced and Readable say "the women of your people" for "the daughters of your people", which means the women among them.

decisions.choice: "네 얼굴을 ~에게 향하고" (L), "~을 마주 보고 서서" (B), "~ 쪽으로 돌아서라" (R) for "set your face toward"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for sim panekha 'el (see 6:2).

decisions.choice: "pon tu rostro hacia" (L); "vuélvete de cara a" (B); "vuélvete hacia" (R)
decisions.reason: Sim panekha 'el as the terms note sets it for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "kaza uso wako kuelekea" (L); "geuka uwaelekee" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's idiom "set your face toward", as the Swahili Jeremiah 44:11 and Luke 9:51 word it at Literal; Balanced and Readable give the plain sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "binti za watu wako" (L); "wanawake" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "daughters of your people"; Balanced and Readable say "women", as the English.

decisions.choice: "hãy xây mặt về phía" (L); "hãy quay mặt về phía" (B); "hãy quay về phía" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for sim panekha 'el; "nghịch cùng" is kept for the Hebrew "against".

decisions.choice: ’tourne ta face vers’ (L); ’tourne ton regard vers’ (B); ’tourne-toi vers’ (R) for sim panekha el, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The book’s term list; the idiom means turning toward someone to speak against them (6:2), which Readable says plainly.

decisions.choice: "ፊትህን ወደ ... አቅና" (L, B); "ወደ ... ዞር በል" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms list sets "set your face toward" as "ፊትህን ወደ ... አቅና" through Ezekiel; Readable follows the English "turn toward".

decisions.choice: अपना मुख ... की ओर करो (L); ... की ओर मुँह करो (B); ... की ओर मुड़ो (R)
decisions.reason: "Set your face toward" is settled at each level here: Literal keeps the face, as 6:2; Balanced keeps it as a plain command; Readable says "turn toward", as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: स्त्रियाँ
decisions.reason: "The daughters of your people" are the women among them (m1); Balanced and Readable say स्त्रियाँ, Literal keeps बेटियाँ.

decisions.choice: обрати своё лицо к (L); повернись лицом к (B); повернись к (R)
decisions.reason: "Set your face toward" in one wording per level, as the English: Literal keeps the face, Balanced and Readable say the gesture plainly (m2).

decisions.choice: benot 'ammekha "あなたの民の娘たち" (L), "あなたの民の女たち" (B, R); sim panekha as notes/EZK-EZK-1.md ("あなたの顔を…に向け" L, "…の方に顔を向け" B, "…の方を向きなさい" R); the women are "彼女たち".
decisions.reason: Women of Israel who acted as prophets, here false ones (m1); 彼女たち is used for these women, as real people (not for a city).

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הוֹי֩ לִֽמְתַפְּר֨וֹת כְּסָת֜וֹת עַ֣ל׀כָּל־אַצִּילֵ֣י יָדַ֗י וְעֹשׂ֧וֹת הַמִּסְפָּח֛וֹת עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל־קוֹמָ֖ה לְצוֹדֵ֣ד נְפָשׁ֑וֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ תְּצוֹדֵ֣דְנָה לְעַמִּ֔י וּנְפָשׁ֖וֹת לָכֶ֥נָה תְחַיֶּֽינָה׃

records.literal_gloss: and say, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Woe to [the women] sewing bands on all joints of my hands, and making the veils for [the] head of every height, to hunt souls! [Will] the souls you hunt of my people, and souls for yourselves you keep alive?

en.L: and say, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Woe to the women who sew bands on all the joints of the hands and make veils for the head of [people of] every height, to hunt souls! Will you hunt down the souls of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people and keep souls alive for yourselves?
en.B: and say: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Woe to the women who sew bands for everyone's wrists and make head veils for people of every height, to hunt down lives! Will you hunt down the lives of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people and keep yourselves alive?
en.R: and tell them that this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: How terrible it will be for you women! You sew magic bands for people's wrists. You make veils of every size for their heads. You do this to trap people. Do you think you can trap the lives of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people and still save your own lives?

pt.L: e dize: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Ai das que costuram faixas sobre todas as juntas das mãos e fazem véus para a cabeça [de pessoas] de toda estatura, para caçar almas! Caçarão vocês as almas do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo e conservarão vivas almas para si mesmas?
pt.B: e dize: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Ai das mulheres que costuram faixas para os pulsos de todos e fazem véus para a cabeça de gente de toda estatura, para caçar vidas! Vocês caçarão as vidas do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo e conservarão a vida de vocês mesmas?
pt.R: e dize a elas que é isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: Que desgraça vai cair sobre vocês, mulheres! Vocês costuram faixas mágicas para os pulsos das pessoas. Fazem véus de todos os tamanhos para a cabeça delas. Fazem isso para pegar as pessoas numa armadilha. Vocês acham que podem prender a vida do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo e ainda salvar a própria vida?

ko.L: 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 모든 손목에 띠를 꿰매어 달고, 온갖 키[의 사람들의] 머리에 쓸 너울을 만들어 영혼들을 사냥하는 여자들에게 화가 있다! 너희가 내 백성의 영혼들은 사냥하면서, 너희 자신을 위해서는 영혼들을 살려 두겠느냐?
ko.B: 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 사람들의 손목마다 띠를 꿰매어 달아 주고, 키가 큰 사람이든 작은 사람이든 머리에 쓸 너울을 만들어 주면서 사람의 목숨을 사냥하는 여자들에게 화가 있다! 너희가 내 백성의 목숨은 사냥하면서 너희 자신의 목숨은 살리겠다는 것이냐?
ko.R: 그들에게 이렇게 전하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희 여자들에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! 너희는 사람들의 손목에 감을 부적 띠를 만든다. 크고 작은 온갖 머릿수건을 만들어 사람들에게 씌운다. 너희는 이렇게 해서 사람들을 덫에 빠뜨린다. 너희가 내 백성의 목숨을 덫으로 잡으면서 너희 자신의 목숨은 건질 수 있다고 생각하느냐?

fr.L: et dis : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Malheur à celles qui cousent des bandelettes pour toutes les jointures des mains, et qui font des voiles pour la tête de [gens de] toute taille, pour chasser des âmes ! Chasserez-vous les âmes de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et garderez-vous en vie des âmes pour vous-mêmes ?
fr.B: et dis : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Malheur à celles qui cousent des bandelettes pour les poignets de chacun et font des voiles pour des têtes de toute taille, afin de traquer des vies ! Traquerez-vous les vies de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple et vous garderez-vous en vie ?
fr.R: et dis-leur : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Quel malheur pour vous, les femmes ! Vous cousez des bandelettes magiques pour les poignets des gens. Vous faites des voiles de toutes tailles pour leur tête. Vous faites cela pour prendre les gens au piège. Croyez-vous pouvoir prendre au piège la vie des gens de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple et sauver votre propre vie ?

es.L: y di: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: ¡Ay de las que cosen cintas para todas las coyunturas de las manos y hacen velos para la cabeza de [gente de] toda estatura, para cazar almas! ¿{{plural_you:Cazarán|Cazaréis}} las almas de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo y {{plural_you:conservarán|conservaréis}} con vida almas para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}?
es.B: y di: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: ¡Ay de las mujeres que cosen cintas para las muñecas de todos y hacen velos para la cabeza de gente de toda estatura, para cazar vidas! ¿{{plural_you:Van a cazar|Vais a cazar}} las vidas de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo y a conservar {{plural_you:su propia vida|vuestra propia vida}}?
es.R: y diles que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: ¡Qué terrible será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}, mujeres! {{plural_you:Cosen|Coséis}} cintas mágicas para las muñecas de la gente. {{plural_you:Hacen|Hacéis}} velos de todos los tamaños para su cabeza. Lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} para atrapar a la gente. ¿{{plural_you:Creen que pueden|Creéis que podéis}} atrapar la vida de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo y aun así salvar {{plural_you:su propia vida|vuestra propia vida}}?

sw.L: useme, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Ole, wanawake wanaoshona kanda juu ya viungo vyote vya mikono, na kutengeneza shela kwa ajili ya vichwa vya [watu wa] kila kimo, ili kuwinda nafsi! Je, mtaziwinda nafsi za watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na kujihifadhia nafsi hai kwa ajili yenu wenyewe?
sw.B: useme: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ole wao wanawake wanaoshona kanda kwa ajili ya vifundo vya mikono ya watu wote, na kutengeneza shela za vichwa kwa ajili ya watu wa kila kimo, ili kuwinda maisha ya watu! Je, mtawinda maisha ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na kujiokoa wenyewe?
sw.R: uwaambie kwamba hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwenu, enyi wanawake! Mnashona kanda za uchawi kwa ajili ya vifundo vya mikono ya watu. Mnatengeneza shela za kila kipimo kwa ajili ya vichwa vyao. Mnafanya hivyo ili kuwanasa watu. Je, mnadhani mnaweza kuyanasa maisha ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na bado kuyaokoa maisha yenu wenyewe?

vi.L: và hãy nói: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Khốn cho những người nữ may các dải băng trên mọi khớp tay và làm khăn trùm cho đầu [người] thuộc mọi tầm vóc, để săn bắt các linh hồn! Các ngươi săn bắt các linh hồn của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mà lại giữ các linh hồn sống cho mình sao?
vi.B: và hãy nói: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Khốn cho những người nữ may các dải băng cho cổ tay mọi người và làm khăn trùm đầu cho người thuộc mọi tầm vóc, để săn bắt mạng sống người ta! Các ngươi muốn săn bắt mạng sống của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà giữ mạng sống mình sao?

Các ngươi làm khăn trùm đầu đủ mọi cỡ cho họ. Các ngươi làm vậy để bẫy người ta. Các ngươi tưởng mình có thể bẫy mạng sống của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà vẫn cứu được mạng sống mình sao?

am.L: እንዲህም በል፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ነፍሳትን ለማጥመድ በእጆች መገጣጠሚያ ሁሉ ላይ ክታቦችን ለሚሰፉ፣ ለየቁመቱም ሁሉ ራስ መሸፈኛዎችን ለሚሠሩ [ሴቶች] ወዮላቸው! የሕዝቤን ነፍሳት ታጠምዳላችሁን? ለራሳችሁስ ነፍሳትን በሕይወት ታኖራላችሁን?
am.B: እንዲህም በላቸው፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ የሰዎችን ሕይወት ለማጥመድ ለሰው ሁሉ የእጅ አንጓ ክታብ ለሚሰፉ፣ ለየቁመቱም ሁሉ ራስ መሸፈኛ ለሚሠሩ ሴቶች ወዮላቸው! የሕዝቤን ሕይወት እያጠመዳችሁ የራሳችሁን ሕይወት ታተርፋላችሁን?
am.R: ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ እንደሚል ንገራቸው፦ እናንተ ሴቶች፣ ወዮላችሁ! ለሰዎች የእጅ አንጓ የአስማት ክታብ ትሰፋላችሁ። በየመጠኑ የራስ መሸፈኛ ትሠራላችሁ። ይህንም የምታደርጉት ሰዎችን ለማጥመድ ነው። የሕዝቤን ሕይወት እያጠመዳችሁ የራሳችሁን ሕይወት ማዳን የምትችሉ ይመስላችኋልን?

hi.L: और कहो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: हाय उन स्त्रियों पर जो हाथों के सब जोड़ों के लिए पट्टियाँ सीती हैं, और हर ऊँचाई के [लोगों के] सिर के लिए ओढ़नियाँ बनाती हैं, ताकि प्राणों का शिकार करें! क्या तुम मेरी प्रजा के प्राणों का शिकार करोगी और अपने लिए प्राणों को जीवित रखोगी?
hi.B: और कहो: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: हाय उन स्त्रियों पर जो सबकी कलाइयों के लिए पट्टियाँ सीती हैं और हर क़द के लोगों के सिर के लिए ओढ़नियाँ बनाती हैं, ताकि लोगों के प्राणों का शिकार करें! क्या तुम मेरी प्रजा के प्राणों का शिकार करोगी और अपने प्राण बचाए रखोगी?
hi.R: और उनसे कहो कि प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: तुम स्त्रियों के लिए कितना भयानक होगा! तुम लोगों की कलाइयों के लिए जादू की पट्टियाँ सीती हो। तुम उनके सिरों के लिए हर नाप की ओढ़नियाँ बनाती हो। यह सब तुम लोगों को फँसाने के लिए करती हो। क्या तुम सोचती हो कि मेरी प्रजा के प्राणों को फँसाकर भी तुम अपने प्राण बचा लोगी?

ru.L: и скажи: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Горе сшивающим повязки на все суставы рук и делающим покрывала на голову [людей] всякого роста, чтобы ловить души! Неужели вы будете ловить души {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа, а свои души сохранять живыми?
ru.B: и скажи: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Горе женщинам, которые шьют повязки на запястья всем и делают покрывала на голову людям всякого роста, чтобы охотиться за жизнями! Неужели вы будете охотиться за жизнями {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа, а себя сохранять в живых?
ru.R: и скажи им: Вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Беда ждёт вас, женщины! Вы шьёте волшебные повязки людям на запястья. Вы делаете им на голову покрывала любого размера. Вы делаете это, чтобы ловить людей. Неужели вы думаете, что можете ловить жизни {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа и при этом сохранить свои жизни?

ja.L: そして言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。ああ、災いだ、魂を狩るために、すべての手首にひもを縫いつけ、あらゆる背丈の[人の]頭のために覆い布を作る女たちは！あなたがたは、わたしの民の魂を狩り、自分たちのために魂を生かしておこうとするのか？
ja.B: そして言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。ああ、災いだ、人の命を狩るために、だれの手首にもつけるひもを縫い、どんな背丈の人の頭にも合うベールを作る女たちは！あなたがたは、わたしの民の命を狩りながら、自分たちは生き延びようとするのか？
ja.R: そして、彼女たちにこう言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。ああ、あなたたち女は、なんとひどい目にあうことか！あなたたちは、人々の手首につけるまじないのひもを縫い、いろいろな大きさの頭にかぶせるベールを作る。そうやって、人々をわなにかけている。あなたたちは、わたしの民の命をわなにかけておきながら、自分の命は救えると思っているのか？

decisions.choice: bands and veils: objects used in some kind of magic
decisions.reason: Both words are found only in this passage, and what the objects were is not certain. The bands, tied on the wrists, and the cloths or veils, worn on the head, seem to have been used in rites to bind or protect people, like the binding spells known from Babylonian magic. "Every height" may mean people of every size, or veils of every length.

decisions.choice: souls: lives, living persons
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means a living being, a person's life. To "hunt souls" is to trap people's lives, holding life and death over them (13:19).

decisions.choice: "Will you hunt the souls of my people and keep souls alive for yourselves?"
alternatives: "You hunt my people's lives, but keep your own lives safe"
"keep lives alive for your own profit"
decisions.reason: The question may ask whether the women can trap others and expect to save themselves, or it may charge them with deciding who lives for their own gain. The phrase "for yourselves" allows both.

decisions.choice: the joints of the hands: the Hebrew text has "my hands"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "all the joints of my hands", which makes little sense in the context; it is usually read as "hands" with a small change of vowels.

decisions.choice: Woe to (L, B); How terrible it will be for (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this cry, as in 13:3.

decisions.choice: lives (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "souls". Balanced and Readable say "lives", since in English "soul" suggests only the inner self, not the whole living person (m2).

decisions.choice: almas (L); vidas (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps "almas"; Balanced and Readable say "vidas", since "alma" in Portuguese suggests only the inner self, not the whole living person (m2). The women are addressed together with "vocês", in the feminine ("vocês mesmas").

decisions.choice: "띠" (L, B), "부적 띠" (R) for the bands; "너울" (L, B), "머릿수건" (R) for the veils; "영혼" (L), "목숨" (B, R) for nefesh
decisions.reason: The objects are uncertain (see the shared footnote), so L and B name them plainly and R says what the English R says, that they were used for magic. 영혼 at L matches the term sheet's L for nefesh in 18:4; 목숨 gives the sense "lives" that the hunting image needs.

decisions.choice: "almas" (L); "vidas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Nefesh here is life, the living person; Literal keeps "almas", the other levels say "vidas" or "la gente", as the English does.

decisions.choice: plural_you with feminine alternatives: "{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}"
decisions.reason: The women are addressed together in 13:18-23, so the vosotros alternative is feminine throughout.

decisions.choice: "kanda" (bands) and "shela" (veils); Readable "kanda za uchawi"
decisions.reason: Plain words for the objects, since what they were is uncertain (see the meaning decision); Readable adds "za uchawi" (magic) as the English Readable says "magic bands".

decisions.choice: "nafsi" (L); "maisha" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "nafsi" for nefesh; Balanced and Readable say "maisha" (lives), as the English says "lives".

decisions.choice: nefesh: "linh hồn" (L); "mạng sống" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the English Literal's "souls"; Balanced and Readable say what the meaning decision gives, living persons and their lives. The bands are "dải băng" (L, B) and "dải bùa" (R), where the English Readable says "magic bands"; the veils are "khăn trùm (đầu)".

decisions.choice: ’bandelettes’ for the bands, ’voiles’ for the veils; Readable adds ’magiques’ as the English Readable does
decisions.reason: The exact objects are unknown (m1); ’bandelettes’ keeps the plain sense of cloth bands sewn on, without naming a kind of charm.

decisions.choice: ’âmes’ (L); ’vies’ (B); ’la vie des gens’ (R)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: the word means living persons and their lives (m2).

decisions.choice: kesatot "ክታቦች" (bands); mispaḥot "መሸፈኛዎች" (veils); "ማጥመድ" (hunt)
decisions.reason: "ክታብ" is the amulet tied on the body, the nearest Amharic thing to these magic bands; Readable adds "የአስማት". "ማጥመድ" (to trap) is used for "hunt" because the forms of "አደነ" (hunt) and "አዳነ" (save) look alike, and the verse sets hunting against keeping alive.

decisions.choice: प्राण
decisions.reason: "Souls" (nefesh) are lives, living persons (m2). Hindi प्राण says both life and the living person, so it stands at every level; आत्मा would suggest only the inner self.

decisions.choice: पट्टियाँ; ओढ़नियाँ
decisions.reason: The bands and veils were objects of some kind of magic (m1); Hindi names the objects, and Readable adds जादू की, as the English adds "magic".

decisions.choice: души (L); жизни (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "души" for nefesh; Balanced and Readable say "жизни", the whole living person (m2), as the English.

decisions.choice: kesatot "ひも" (L, B), "まじないのひも" (R); mispachot "覆い布" (L), "ベール" (B, R); nefashot "魂" (L), "命" (B, R); tsud "狩る" (L, B), "わなにかける" (R); hoy as 13:3.
decisions.reason: Objects used in some kind of magic (m1, footnoted); souls are lives, living persons (m2). The last question is uncertain (m3); the Hebrew 'my hands' (m4) is read as 'the hands' with the English.

source.text: וַתְּחַלֶּלְ֨נָהאֹתִ֜י אֶל־עַמִּ֗י בְּשַׁעֲלֵ֣י שְׂעֹרִים֮ וּבִפְת֣וֹתֵי לֶחֶם֒ לְהָמִ֤ית נְפָשׁוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־תְמוּתֶ֔נָה וּלְחַיּ֥וֹת נְפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־תִֽחְיֶ֑ינָה בְּכַ֨זֶּבְכֶ֔ם לְעַמִּ֖י שֹׁמְעֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to put to death souls that should not die, and to keep alive souls that should not live, by your lying to my people, who listen to a lie.

en.L: And you have profaned {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people for handfuls of barley and for crumbs of bread, to put to death souls that should not die and to keep alive souls that should not live, by your lies to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, who listen to a lie.
en.B: For a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread you have profaned {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. You have put to death people who should not die and kept alive people who should not live, by lying to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, who listen to lies.
en.R: You have dishonored {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people for a few handfuls of barley and some pieces of bread. By your lies you condemn to death people who should not die, and you promise life to people who should not live. And {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people listen to your lies!

pt.L: E vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} profanaram diante do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo por punhados de cevada e por migalhas de pão, para fazer morrer almas que não deviam morrer e para conservar vivas almas que não deviam viver, com as suas mentiras ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, que escuta a mentira.
pt.B: Por alguns punhados de cevada e pedaços de pão vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} profanaram no meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo. Vocês fizeram morrer pessoas que não deviam morrer e mantiveram vivas pessoas que não deviam viver, mentindo ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, que dá ouvidos a mentiras.
pt.R: Vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desonraram no meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo por alguns punhados de cevada e uns pedaços de pão. Com as suas mentiras vocês condenam à morte pessoas que não deviam morrer e prometem vida a pessoas que não deviam viver. E o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo escuta as mentiras de vocês!

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 보리 몇 줌과 빵 부스러기 때문에 내 백성 가운데서 나를 더럽혔다. 거짓말에 귀를 기울이는 내 백성에게 너희가 거짓말을 하여, 죽어서는 안 될 영혼들을 죽이고 살아서는 안 될 영혼들을 살렸다.
ko.B: 너희는 보리 몇 줌과 빵 몇 조각을 얻으려고 내 백성 앞에서 나를 욕되게 했다. 거짓말에 귀를 기울이는 내 백성에게 거짓말을 하여, 죽어서는 안 될 사람들을 죽이고 살아서는 안 될 사람들을 살려 주었다.
ko.R: 너희는 보리 몇 줌과 빵 몇 조각을 얻으려고 내 백성 앞에서 내 이름을 더럽혔다. 너희는 거짓말로 죽지 않아도 될 사람들에게 죽을 것이라고 말하고, 살아서는 안 될 사람들에게 살 것이라고 말한다. 그런데도 내 백성은 너희의 거짓말을 듣는다!

fr.L: Et vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez profané auprès de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple pour des poignées d’orge et pour des miettes de pain, pour faire mourir des âmes qui ne devaient pas mourir et pour garder en vie des âmes qui ne devaient pas vivre, en mentant à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, qui écoute le mensonge.
fr.B: Pour quelques poignées d’orge et quelques morceaux de pain, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez profané au milieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Vous avez fait mourir des gens qui ne devaient pas mourir, et gardé en vie des gens qui ne devaient pas vivre, en mentant à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, qui écoute les mensonges.
fr.R: Vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez déshonoré au milieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple pour quelques poignées d’orge et quelques morceaux de pain. Par vos mensonges, vous condamnez à mort des gens qui ne devraient pas mourir, et vous promettez la vie à des gens qui ne devraient pas vivre. Et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple écoute vos mensonges !

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han profanado|habéis profanado}} ante {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo por puñados de cebada y por pedazos de pan, para hacer morir a almas que no debían morir y para dar vida a almas que no debían vivir, con {{plural_you:sus mentiras|vuestras mentiras}} a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, que escucha la mentira.
es.B: Por unos puñados de cebada y unos pedazos de pan {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han profanado|habéis profanado}} en medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. {{plural_you:Han dado|Habéis dado}} muerte a personas que no debían morir y {{plural_you:han mantenido|habéis mantenido}} con vida a personas que no debían vivir, mintiéndole a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, que escucha mentiras.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotras}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:han deshonrado|habéis deshonrado}} ante {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo por unos puñados de cebada y unos pedazos de pan. Con {{plural_you:sus mentiras|vuestras mentiras}} {{plural_you:condenan|condenáis}} a muerte a personas que no deberían morir, y {{plural_you:prometen|prometéis}} vida a personas que no deberían vivir. ¡Y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo escucha {{plural_you:sus mentiras|vuestras mentiras}}!

sw.L: Nanyi mmeninajisi mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa ajili ya konzi za shayiri na kwa ajili ya vipande vya mkate, ili kuua nafsi zisizostahili kufa, na kuhifadhi hai nafsi zisizostahili kuishi, kwa uongo wenu kwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, wanaosikiliza uongo.
sw.B: Kwa konzi chache za shayiri na vipande vya mkate mmeninajisi kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Mmewaua watu wasiostahili kufa na kuwaacha hai watu wasiostahili kuishi, kwa kuwaambia uongo watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, wanaosikiliza uongo.
sw.R: Mmenivunjia heshima kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa ajili ya konzi chache za shayiri na vipande vya mkate. Kwa uongo wenu mnawahukumu kifo watu wasiostahili kufa, na mnawaahidi kwamba wataishi watu wasiostahili kuishi. Na watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wanasikiliza uongo wenu!

vi.L: Các ngươi đã làm ô danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vì vài nắm lúa mạch và vài mẩu bánh, để giết những linh hồn không đáng chết và để giữ sống những linh hồn không đáng sống, bằng lời dối trá của các ngươi với dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là dân nghe theo điều dối trá.
vi.B: Vì vài nắm lúa mạch và mấy mẩu bánh, các ngươi đã làm ô danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Các ngươi đã giết những người không đáng chết, và giữ sống những người không đáng sống, bằng cách nói dối với dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là dân hay nghe lời dối trá.
vi.R: Các ngươi đã làm nhục danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chỉ vì vài nắm lúa mạch và mấy mẩu bánh. Bằng những lời dối trá, các ngươi tuyên án chết cho những người không đáng chết, và hứa cho sống những người không đáng sống. Thế mà dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lại nghe theo những lời dối trá của các ngươi!

am.L: ሊሞቱ የማይገባቸውን ነፍሳት ለመግደል፣ በሕይወትም ሊኖሩ የማይገባቸውን ነፍሳት በሕይወት ለማኖር፣ ሐሰትን ለሚሰማው ለሕዝቤ በምትናገሩት ውሸት፣ በእፍኝ ገብስና በቁራሽ እንጀራ በሕዝቤ መካከል አቃለላችሁኝ።
am.B: በጥቂት እፍኝ ገብስና በቁራሽ እንጀራ በሕዝቤ መካከል አቃለላችሁኝ። ሐሰትን ለሚሰማው ሕዝቤ ውሸት በመናገር ሊሞቱ የማይገባቸውን ሰዎች ገደላችሁ፤ ሊኖሩ የማይገባቸውንም በሕይወት አኖራችሁ።
am.R: በጥቂት እፍኝ ገብስና በቁራሽ እንጀራ በሕዝቤ መካከል አዋረዳችሁኝ። በውሸታችሁ ሊሞቱ የማይገባቸውን ሰዎች ሞት ይገባችኋል ትላላችሁ፤ ሊኖሩ የማይገባቸውንም በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ ትላላችሁ። ሕዝቤም ውሸታችሁን ይሰማል!

hi.L: और तुमने मुट्ठी भर जौ और रोटी के टुकड़ों के लिए मेरी प्रजा के बीच मुझे अपवित्र ठहराया है, कि जिन प्राणों को नहीं मरना चाहिए उन्हें मार डालो, और जिन प्राणों को नहीं जीना चाहिए उन्हें जीवित रखो, अपने उस झूठ के द्वारा जो तुम मेरी प्रजा से बोलती हो, जो झूठ सुनती है।
hi.B: थोड़ी-सी मुट्ठी भर जौ और रोटी के टुकड़ों के लिए तुमने मेरी प्रजा के बीच मुझे अपवित्र ठहराया है। मेरी प्रजा से, जो झूठ सुनती है, झूठ बोलकर तुमने उन्हें मार डाला जिन्हें मरना नहीं चाहिए था, और उन्हें जीवित रखा जिन्हें जीना नहीं चाहिए था।
hi.R: थोड़े-से जौ और रोटी के कुछ टुकड़ों के लिए तुमने मेरी प्रजा के बीच मेरा अपमान किया है। अपने झूठ से तुम उन लोगों को मौत की सज़ा सुनाती हो जिन्हें मरना नहीं चाहिए, और उन लोगों को जीवन का वचन देती हो जिन्हें जीना नहीं चाहिए। और मेरी प्रजा तुम्हारा झूठ सुनती है!

ru.L: И вы осквернили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} перед {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом за горсти ячменя и за куски хлеба, умерщвляя души, которые не должны умереть, и оставляя в живых души, которые не должны жить, своей ложью {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} народу, слушающему ложь.
ru.B: За несколько горстей ячменя и куски хлеба вы осквернили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} среди {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа. Вы предавали смерти тех, кто не должен был умереть, и оставляли в живых тех, кто не должен был жить, обманывая {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, который слушает ложь.
ru.R: За несколько горстей ячменя и несколько кусков хлеба вы опозорили {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} перед {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} народом. Своей ложью вы приговариваете к смерти тех, кто не должен умереть, и обещаете жизнь тем, кто не должен жить. А {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ слушает вашу ложь!

ja.L: あなたがたは、一握りの大麦のために、パンのかけらのために、わたしの民の前でわたしを汚した。死ぬべきでない魂を死なせ、生きるべきでない魂を生かしておくために、偽りに聞き従うわたしの民に、あなたがたは偽りを語った。
ja.B: わずか数握りの大麦とパンのかけらのために、あなたがたは、わたしの民の中でわたしを汚した。偽りに耳を傾けるわたしの民にうそを語って、死ぬべきでない人々を死なせ、生きるべきでない人々を生かしてきた。
ja.R: あなたたちは、わずかな大麦とパンのかけらのために、わたしの民の前で、わたしの名をはずかしめた。うそをついて、死ぬはずのない人々に死を宣告し、生きるはずのない人々に命を約束している。そして、わたしの民は、あなたたちのうそに耳を傾けている！

decisions.choice: handfuls of barley and pieces of bread: the small fees paid for their services
alternatives: grain and bread used in their rites
decisions.reason: People paid seers and prophets with food (1 Samuel 9:7-8; Micah 3:5, 11). The point is how little the women gain for dishonoring the LORD.

decisions.choice: putting to death and keeping alive: pronouncing life and death over people by their lies
decisions.reason: The women do not kill with their own hands. By their sayings and rites they condemn the innocent and reassure the guilty; 13:22 explains this as discouraging the righteous and encouraging the wicked.

decisions.choice: profaned me: treated the LORD's name as common by using it for gain
decisions.reason: To profane is to treat what is holy as ordinary. The women claimed the LORD's authority for their own business.

decisions.choice: condemn to death; promise life
decisions.reason: Readable says how the women "kill" and "keep alive": by what they say (m2).

decisions.choice: "by your lies to my people, who listen to a lie" is moved before the verbs it explains
decisions.reason: Korean puts the means before the main verbs; the content stays within verse 19.

decisions.choice: "làm ô danh Ta" (L, B); "làm nhục danh Ta" (R)
decisions.reason: "Profane" with God as object is worded as Leviticus 18:21 and Jeremiah 34:16: Vietnamese profanes God's name, which is what the meaning decision says is meant.

decisions.choice: मुझे अपवित्र ठहराया
decisions.reason: To profane the LORD is to treat his name as common by using it for gain (m3); Literal and Balanced keep अपवित्र, Readable says "dishonored", as the English does.

decisions.choice: chillel "汚した" (L, B), "わたしの名をはずかしめた" (R); sha'ale se'orim / petote lechem "一握りの大麦" / "パンのかけら".
decisions.reason: Treating the LORD's name as common by using it for gain (m3); the small fees for their services (m1, uncertain). R makes 'name' explicit as m3 says.

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֤י אֶל־כִּסְּתוֹתֵיכֶ֨נָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֠תֵּנָה מְצֹדְד֨וֹת שָׁ֤ם אֶת־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לְפֹ֣רְח֔וֹת וְקָרַעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל זְרוֹעֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי֙ אֶת־הַנְּפָשׁ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם מְצֹדְד֥וֹת אֶת־נְפָשִׁ֖ים לְפֹרְחֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Behold, I [am] against your bands with which you hunt there the souls like birds, and I will tear them from upon your arms, and I will set free the souls, [the] souls that you hunt like birds.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Look, I [am] against your bands, with which you hunt the souls there like birds, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will set free the souls, the souls that you hunt like birds.
en.B: Therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I am against your bands, with which you hunt down lives as if they were birds. I will tear them from your arms and set free the lives you hunt down like birds.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I am against the magic bands you use to trap people like birds. I will tear them off your arms. I will set free the people you have trapped like birds.

pt.L: Por isso, assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Eis que eu [estou] contra as faixas de vocês, com que vocês caçam ali as almas como aves, e as arrancarei dos seus braços; e soltarei as almas, as almas que vocês caçam como aves.
pt.B: Por isso, assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}: Estou contra as faixas de vocês, com que vocês caçam vidas como se fossem aves. Eu as arrancarei dos seus braços e soltarei as vidas que vocês caçam como aves.
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz: Estou contra as faixas mágicas que vocês usam para prender as pessoas como passarinhos. Vou arrancá-las dos braços de vocês. Vou soltar as pessoas que vocês prenderam como passarinhos.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 보아라, 너희가 거기서 영혼들을 새처럼 사냥하는 데 쓰는 너희의 띠를 내가 대적한다. 내가 너희 팔에서 그것들을 찢어 내고, 너희가 새처럼 사냥하는 영혼들, 곧 그 영혼들을 놓아 주겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희가 사람의 목숨을 새처럼 사냥하는 데 쓰는 그 띠를 내가 대적한다. 내가 그것들을 너희 팔에서 찢어 내고, 너희가 새처럼 사냥한 목숨들을 놓아 주겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희는 부적 띠로 사람들을 새처럼 덫에 빠뜨리지만, 나는 그 띠를 그냥 두지 않겠다. 내가 그것을 너희 팔에서 찢어 내겠다. 너희가 새처럼 잡은 사람들을 내가 풀어 주겠다.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, je [suis] contre vos bandelettes, avec lesquelles vous chassez là les âmes comme des oiseaux, et je les arracherai de vos bras ; et je libérerai les âmes, les âmes que vous chassez comme des oiseaux.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je suis contre vos bandelettes, avec lesquelles vous traquez des vies comme on chasse les oiseaux. Je les arracherai de vos bras, et je libérerai les vies que vous traquez comme des oiseaux.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je suis contre les bandelettes magiques que vous utilisez pour prendre les gens au piège comme des oiseaux. Je les arracherai de vos bras. Je libérerai les gens que vous avez pris au piège comme des oiseaux.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: He aquí, yo [estoy] contra {{plural_you:sus cintas|vuestras cintas}}, con que {{plural_you:cazan|cazáis}} allí las almas como a aves, y las arrancaré de {{plural_you:sus brazos|vuestros brazos}}; y dejaré libres las almas, las almas que {{plural_you:ustedes cazan|vosotras cazáis}} como a aves.
es.B: Por eso, el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Yo estoy contra {{plural_you:sus cintas|vuestras cintas}}, con las que {{plural_you:cazan|cazáis}} vidas como si fueran pájaros. Las arrancaré de {{plural_you:sus brazos|vuestros brazos}} y dejaré libres las vidas que {{plural_you:cazan|cazáis}} como a pájaros.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Yo estoy contra las cintas mágicas que {{plural_you:usan|usáis}} para atrapar a la gente como a pájaros. Se las arrancaré de los brazos. Dejaré libres a las personas que {{plural_you:han atrapado|habéis atrapado}} como a pájaros.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] dhidi ya kanda zenu, ambazo kwa hizo mnawinda nafsi huko kama ndege, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitazirarua kutoka mikononi mwenu; {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaziachilia huru nafsi, nafsi mnazoziwinda kama ndege.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Mimi ni kinyume cha kanda zenu, ambazo kwa hizo mnawinda maisha ya watu kana kwamba ni ndege. Nitazirarua kutoka mikononi mwenu na kuyaachilia huru maisha mnayoyawinda kama ndege.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Mimi ni kinyume cha kanda za uchawi mnazotumia kuwanasa watu kama ndege. Nitazirarua kutoka mikononi mwenu. Nitawaachilia huru watu mliowanasa kama ndege.

vi.L: Vì vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng các dải băng của các ngươi, là thứ các ngươi dùng để săn bắt các linh hồn tại đó như săn chim, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xé chúng khỏi cánh tay các ngươi; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thả các linh hồn ra, là các linh hồn mà các ngươi săn bắt như săn chim.
vi.B: Vì thế, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ta nghịch cùng các dải băng của các ngươi, thứ các ngươi dùng để săn bắt mạng sống người ta như săn chim. Ta sẽ xé chúng khỏi cánh tay các ngươi và thả những mạng sống mà các ngươi săn bắt như chim.
vi.R: Vậy đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta chống lại những dải bùa các ngươi dùng để bẫy người ta như bẫy chim. Ta sẽ giật chúng khỏi cánh tay các ngươi. Ta sẽ thả những người các ngươi đã bẫy như bẫy chim.

am.L: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ፣ ነፍሳትን እንደ ወፎች በዚያ በምታጠምዱባቸው ክታቦቻችሁ ላይ ነኝ፤ ከክንዶቻችሁም ላይ እቀድዳቸዋለሁ፤ ነፍሳትንም፣ እንደ ወፎች የምታጠምዷቸውን ነፍሳት፣ ነጻ እለቃለሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ የሰዎችን ሕይወት እንደ ወፍ በምታጠምዱባቸው ክታቦቻችሁ ላይ ነኝ። ከክንዶቻችሁ ላይ ቀድጄ እንደ ወፍ የምታጠምዱትን ሕይወት ነጻ እለቃለሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ሰዎችን እንደ ወፍ የምታጠምዱባቸውን የአስማት ክታቦቻችሁን እቃወማለሁ። ከክንዶቻችሁ ላይ እቀድዳቸዋለሁ። እንደ ወፍ ያጠመዳችኋቸውን ሰዎች ነጻ አወጣቸዋለሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: देखो, मैं तुम्हारी उन पट्टियों के विरुद्ध [हूँ] जिनसे तुम वहाँ प्राणों का पक्षियों के समान शिकार करती हो, और मैं उन्हें तुम्हारी बाँहों पर से फाड़ डालूँगा; और मैं उन प्राणों को, जिन प्राणों का तुम पक्षियों के समान शिकार करती हो, छुड़ा दूँगा।
hi.B: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: मैं तुम्हारी उन पट्टियों के विरुद्ध हूँ जिनसे तुम लोगों के प्राणों का ऐसे शिकार करती हो मानो वे पक्षी हों। मैं उन्हें तुम्हारी बाँहों पर से फाड़ डालूँगा, और जिन प्राणों का तुम पक्षियों की तरह शिकार करती हो, उन्हें छुड़ा दूँगा।
hi.R: इसलिए प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: मैं जादू की उन पट्टियों के विरुद्ध हूँ जिनसे तुम लोगों को पक्षियों की तरह फँसाती हो। मैं उन्हें तुम्हारी बाँहों पर से फाड़ डालूँगा। जिन लोगों को तुमने पक्षियों की तरह फँसा रखा है, उन्हें मैं छुड़ा दूँगा।

ru.L: Поэтому так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — против ваших повязок, которыми вы там ловите души, как птиц, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сорву их с ваших рук; и отпущу души, души, которые вы ловите, как птиц.
ru.B: Поэтому так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Я — против ваших повязок, которыми вы ловите жизни, как птиц. Я сорву их с ваших рук и освобожу жизни, за которыми вы охотитесь, как за птицами.
ru.R: Поэтому вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Я — против волшебных повязок, которыми вы ловите людей, как птиц. Я сорву их с ваших рук. Я освобожу людей, которых вы поймали, как птиц.

ja.L: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。見なさい、わたしは、あなたがたがそこで魂を鳥のように狩る、あなたがたのひもに立ち向かう。わたしはそれをあなたがたの腕から引きちぎり、あなたがたが鳥のように狩る魂、その魂を解き放つ。
ja.B: それゆえ、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは、あなたがたが人の命を鳥のように狩るのに使うひもに立ち向かう。わたしはそれをあなたがたの腕から引きちぎり、あなたがたが鳥のように狩る命を解き放つ。
ja.R: だから、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。わたしは、あなたたちが人々を鳥のようにわなにかけるのに使う、まじないのひもに立ち向かう。わたしはそれを、あなたたちの腕から引きちぎる。そして、あなたたちが鳥のようにわなにかけた人々を、自由にする。

decisions.choice: like birds
decisions.reason: The word is rare and may mean "as birds" or "to make them fly". The picture is of a fowler trapping birds; the LORD will release them.

decisions.choice: there: the meaning of the word here is unclear
decisions.reason: "There" has no clear place to refer to; it may mean "in that way" or point to the places where the rites were done.

decisions.choice: lefore chot "鳥のように" at every level; sham "そこで" at L only; hineni 'el "わたしは…に立ち向かう" as 13:8.
decisions.reason: Both 'like birds' and 'there' are uncertain (m1, m2); B and R leave sham out as the English.

source.text: וְקָרַעְתִּ֞י אֶת־מִסְפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן וְלֹֽא־יִהְי֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּיֶדְכֶ֖ן לִמְצוּדָ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will tear your veils and deliver my people from your hand, and not they will be again in your hand as prey; and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And I will tear off your veils and rescue {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people from your hand, and they will no longer be in your hand as prey; and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will tear off your veils and rescue {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people from your power, and they will no longer be caught in your grip. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will tear off your veils and rescue {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people from you. You will not be able to trap them anymore. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: E rasgarei os véus de vocês e livrarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo da mão de vocês, e não estarão mais na mão de vocês como presa; e vocês saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Rasgarei os véus de vocês e livrarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo do poder de vocês, e eles não serão mais apanhados pelas suas mãos. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vou arrancar os véus de vocês e salvar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo das mãos de vocês. Vocês não vão mais conseguir prendê-los. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너희의 너울을 찢고 내 백성을 너희 손에서 건져 내겠다. 그들이 다시는 너희 손에 사냥감이 되지 않을 것이다. 그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 너희의 너울을 찢어 버리고 내 백성을 너희 손아귀에서 건져 내겠다. 그들이 다시는 너희에게 사냥감처럼 잡히지 않을 것이다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너희의 머릿수건을 찢어 버리고 내 백성을 너희에게서 구해 내겠다. 너희는 다시는 그들을 덫으로 잡지 못할 것이다. 그러면 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

fr.L: Et je déchirerai vos voiles et je délivrerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple de votre main, et ils ne seront plus dans votre main comme une proie ; et vous saurez que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: J’arracherai vos voiles et je délivrerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple de votre pouvoir, et ils ne seront plus pris dans vos griffes. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: J’arracherai vos voiles et je délivrerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple de vos mains. Vous ne pourrez plus les prendre au piège. Alors vous saurez que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y rasgaré {{plural_you:sus velos|vuestros velos}} y libraré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo de {{plural_you:su mano|vuestra mano}}, y no estarán más en {{plural_you:su mano|vuestra mano}} como presa; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Rasgaré {{plural_you:sus velos|vuestros velos}} y rescataré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo de {{plural_you:su poder|vuestro poder}}, y ya no caerá más en {{plural_you:sus garras|vuestras garras}}. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Arrancaré {{plural_you:sus velos|vuestros velos}} y rescataré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}. Ya no {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} atraparlo. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitazirarua shela zenu na kuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka mkononi mwenu, wala hawatakuwa tena mkononi mwenu kama mawindo; nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitazirarua shela zenu na kuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka katika mamlaka yenu, wala hawatanaswa tena mikononi mwenu. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitazirarua shela zenu na kuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka kwenu. Hamtaweza kuwanasa tena. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ xé khăn trùm của các ngươi và giải cứu dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi tay các ngươi, và họ sẽ không còn ở trong tay các ngươi làm mồi nữa; và các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ta sẽ xé khăn trùm của các ngươi và giải cứu dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi quyền lực các ngươi, và họ sẽ không còn bị các ngươi nắm giữ nữa. Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Ta sẽ giật khăn trùm của các ngươi và giải cứu dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi tay các ngươi. Các ngươi sẽ không thể bẫy họ nữa. Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

am.L: መሸፈኛዎቻችሁንም እቀድዳለሁ፤ ሕዝቤንም ከእጃችሁ እታደጋለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህም እንደ አደን ሆነው በእጃችሁ አይገኙም፤ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።
am.B: መሸፈኛዎቻችሁን ቀድጄ ሕዝቤን ከእጃችሁ እታደጋለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህም በመዳፋችሁ ውስጥ አይያዙም። በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።
am.R: መሸፈኛዎቻችሁን ቀድጄ ሕዝቤን ከእናንተ እታደጋለሁ። ከእንግዲህ ልታጠምዷቸው አትችሉም። በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ታውቃላችሁ።

hi.L: और मैं तुम्हारी ओढ़नियाँ फाड़ डालूँगा और अपनी प्रजा को तुम्हारे हाथ से छुड़ाऊँगा, और वे फिर तुम्हारे हाथ में शिकार न रहेंगे; और तुम जान लोगी कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हारी ओढ़नियाँ फाड़ डालूँगा और अपनी प्रजा को तुम्हारे वश से छुड़ाऊँगा, और वे फिर तुम्हारी पकड़ में न रहेंगे। तब तुम जान लोगी कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हारी ओढ़नियाँ फाड़ डालूँगा और अपनी प्रजा को तुमसे छुड़ा लूँगा। तुम उन्हें फिर नहीं फँसा सकोगी। तब तुम जान लोगी कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сорву ваши покрывала и избавлю {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ из вашей руки, и не будут они больше в вашей руке добычей; и узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Я сорву ваши покрывала и избавлю {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ из вашей власти, и они больше не станут вашей добычей. Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Я сорву ваши покрывала и спасу {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ от вас. Вы больше не сможете их ловить. Тогда вы узнаете, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そしてわたしは、あなたがたの覆い布を引き裂き、わたしの民をあなたがたの手から救い出す。彼らはもはや、あなたがたの手の中で獲物とはならない。そしてあなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。
ja.B: わたしは、あなたがたのベールを引き裂き、わたしの民をあなたがたの手から救い出す。彼らはもはや、あなたがたの手に捕らえられることはない。そのとき、あなたがたは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちのベールを引き裂いて、わたしの民をあなたたちから救い出す。あなたたちは、もう彼らをわなにかけることはできない。そのとき、あなたたちは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。
